text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The sun rises on the Japanese<n>Derby. Feeling the
weight of my<n>dream and the crowd's on her
shoulders, Rudolf is understandably a<n>little uptight.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I help her recover her composure, and<n>the
Emperor takes to the track calm,<n>collected, and
with her ideals held<n>high.
